product_goal: IncidentLens: Real-Time Incident Diagnostic & Forensic Analysis Workstation with REST API, local persistence, runbook lookup, WCAG AA dark-mode dashboard, automated test verification, and continuous incident autopsy logging

brain_intelligence_guidelines.title: Domain L — Deployment & Operations: Chunked Multi-Part Vault Backup & 1-Click Recovery
brain_intelligence_guidelines.invariant: Disaster recovery snapshots must atomically chunk repositories into 45MB parts to strictly comply with GitHub 100MB blob limits, encrypt credentials with AES-256-GCM, and verify 100% SHA-256 manifest parity prior to state restore.

observability_invariants: Structured JSON logs for all critical failure boundaries
Zero PII or credentials recorded in telemetry
